discovery.Peers

Class to get data from peers function.

Available as lseg.data.discovery.Peers.

Syntax

Peers(expression)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
expression Yes peers expression

Properties

Property Description
expression Expression used to request the universe, e.g. 'peers(VOD.L)' for Peers or 'screen(...)' for Screener.

Example

peers = Peers("VOD.L")
print(list(peers))
